# AgentGlow

> Watch AI agents and whole backends live in 3D, from the OpenTelemetry they already emit. A Python server
> (`agentglow serve`, port 8100) maps spans, Claude Code hooks and flat HTTP events to a 3D scene. One line to
> instrument: `agentglow.watch()` (LangChain, LangGraph, deepagents, OpenAI Agents SDK, Hatchet, MCP),
> `agentglow.watch(app=/broker=/mcp=)` (FastAPI, FastStream, FastMCP), `watch()` from `agentglow/node` (Node,
> Next.js), `npx agentglow setup` (Claude Code). Packages: PyPI `agentglow`, npm `agentglow`. MIT.

## Using AgentGlow

- [Skill (start here)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/SKILL.md): decision tree and common recipes for agents
- [Claude Code setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/setup-claude-code.md): `npx agentglow setup`, plugin, token counts
- [Python agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/python-agents.md): `watch()`, frameworks, manual API, waits, scopes
- [Backend services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/backend-services.md): FastAPI, FastStream, FastMCP, `watch()` arguments, job nodes
- [Generic primitives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/primitives.md): session, stage, progress, pool, job, gate, backlog, ...
- [Node / Next.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/node.md): `agentglow/node`, `agentglow/pulse`
- [HTTP, OTLP, auth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/events-http.md): `/v1/events`, `/v1/traces`, ingest keys, viewer tokens, endpoints
- [React embed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/react-embed.md): `<AgentScene/>` props and themes
- [Privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/privacy.md): what is kept and dropped
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/troubleshooting.md)
- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/skills/agentglow/references/recipes.md): FastAPI + FastStream, deepagents + Hatchet, Next.js BFF, voice sessions, pipelines

## Reference

- [README](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/blob/main/README.md): overview, get started, primitives, themes, security
- [SPEC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/docs/SPEC.md): the contract (endpoints, span to world event mapping, attributes, privacy)
- [Python package README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/backend/README.md)
- [npm package README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/main/frontend/README.md): CLI, `<AgentScene/>`, `agentglow/node`

## Examples

- [fastapi-faststream](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/fastapi-faststream): a backend with every primitive, no LLM key
- [deepagents-hatchet](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/deepagents-hatchet): the docker compose demo stack (trading desk flagship)
- [node-proxy](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/node-proxy), [custom-loop](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/custom-loop), [quickstart](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/quickstart), [langgraph](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/langgraph), [openai-agents](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/openai-agents), [react-embed](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/react-embed), [claude-code](https://github.com/Nideesh1/agentglow/tree/main/examples/claude-code)
